answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in wharf, expire in pigment, and yarrow lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 103 aliases hence needs 16 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3986 identities would post 4359 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
